name: Letta Code
description: Memory-first coding agent harness whose agents persist and learn across sessions instead of starting fresh each time.
whatItDoes: Letta Code is a coding agent that remembers your projects, preferences and past work. The same long-lived agent can be reached from the terminal, a desktop app, a web chat or messaging channels. It suits developers who want an assistant that improves with use.
howItWorks: Agents are stateful objects stored on a Letta backend, which is the hosted cloud by default or a local server. The CLI attaches to an agent and gives it coding tools while the backend manages its memory. Users can connect their own model keys from inside the app.

requirements.name: Letta account or local backend
requirements.description: Stores agent state; Letta Cloud is the default

models: Models offered through Letta or your own provider keys
